scope: Core credential atomicity and Boat workspace strategy review fixes

genericContract.behavior: Optional existingBranch attachment intent round-trips independently of branchCreatedByRuntime ownership. No Boat implementation.

implementation.credentials: Candidate configuration, secret binding, computer attachment and activation use the exact same database transaction. Attach rejection rolls back to prior committed authority.
implementation.workspaces: Configured baseRef reaches remote worktree creation. Explicit existingBranch must exist as an exact local ref; no creation/reset/fallback, and existing dirty work remains intact. Unsupported strategy rejects before acquisition.

red.cause: Attach outside transaction allowed previous credential binding replacement to commit first.
Configured base/existing branch ignored; missing branch created or existing branch rejected by create-branch mode.

review.validated: Exact transaction factory argument; independent branch intent; serialization-to-driver propagation; remote exact-ref and dirty-work preservation.

partition.note: Parent owns runtime correction merge and final assembled file count.

limitations: Focused verification only; no claim of new live lifecycle proof.
Parent will integrate the generic contract into the prerequisite, then merge current prerequisite corrections before final PR verification.
